description: Built-in software normalisation rules for services/inventory_normalize.py. Rules run in order and the first match wins: product rules, then noise rules, then the generic fallback in code. name_re is matched with search against the cleaned name after architecture markers ((x64), (64-bit), x86 ...) and trademark marks have been removed, case-insensitively. 'publisher' is a key from vendor_aliases.json and is authoritative for matched products; 'publisher_re' optionally restricts the match to a raw publisher. 'edition' and 'cycle' are re.Match.expand templates; 'cycle_from_version' (major | major_minor) derives the cycle from the version argument instead. 'sources' restricts a rule to those inventory sources. Every rule lists examples that the test-suite checks. Keep patterns linear-time: bounded quantifiers, no nested unbounded repetition. Bump RULEPACK_REV in inventory_normalize.py whenever this file changes.
